annotations.title: Place a planting in a bed

description: Place or move a planting on its bed's layout grid — set its position (xCm, yCm measured from the bed's top-left corner) and footprint (wCm × hCm) in centimeters. Identify the planting by plant name or plantingId. Use when the user wants to arrange, position, or move a plant within its bed. For a planting that already spans several grid squares, use the app's layout editor instead.

garden.description: Garden name; defaults to the user's first garden.

plant.description: Plant name of the planting to place.

xCm.description: X offset from the bed's top-left, in cm (≥ 0).

yCm.description: Y offset from the bed's top-left, in cm (≥ 0).

name: place_planting
